title: synchronize-python-js-go-sdks-dependency-bumps-and-deprecate-legacy-response-wrapper
creator: Asha Kumar
description: Scope: coordinated dependency upgrades across Python, JavaScript, and Go SDKs and removal of the legacy response wrapper API surface. Goals: eliminate multiple security/CI warnings, reduce install-time transitive deps, and remove legacy parameters that complicate server-side routing and runtimes. Work includes: bumping HTTP and gRPC libraries to supported minimums, updating build matrices and Dockerfiles, adding compatibility shims for a single release window, updating CI lint/test matrices, and publishing migration docs and changelogs. Targets: Python: requests 2.31+ and optional httpx path, async support patches; JavaScript: bump node engine to 18, migrate from node-fetch to undici/axios v1.5+, modernize bundler config; Go: update go.mod to 1.21 minimum and upgrade grpc-go and protobuf toolchain. API surface changes: remove `response_wrapper` and `legacy_envelope` options and replace with standard structured response output and transform hooks. Rollout: feature-flagged client releases followed by server-side canary to observe error rate and latency regressions.

Implementation will be removed in the next major scheduled for Q3. Documented in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ENG/SDK+Dep+Upgrade+Plan
